## 🎯 What's New in v2.0.3

### ✨ Features
- **Improved Prediction Algorithm**: Multi-factor analysis with confidence indicators (🎯📊🔮)
- **Notification Timer**: Live timer updates every 10s with "Finish Session" button
- **Check for Updates**: Automatic version checking and APK download in Settings
- **Dynamic Status**: Real-time activity tracking with personalized messages
- **Weekly Wrapped**: Save to gallery + fixed text cutoff issues
- **Demo Data**: 15 days of sample data for new users

### � Improvements
- Better prediction accuracy (21 sessions vs 14)
- Day-of-week and time-of-day pattern detection
- Improved card layouts and sizing
- Performance optimizations

### � Bug Fixes
- Fixed Weekly Wrapped text wrapping
- Fixed notification timer sync
- Removed floating timer (notification-based now)
- Fixed package version conflicts

---

## 📥 Installation

**New Users**: Download APK below, enable "Unknown Sources", install and start tracking!

**Updating**: Install over existing app. Your data will be preserved.

**Requirements**: Android 5.0+, 50 MB storage
